description:
Review finding from worktree-qzr2-wal-trim.

Problem:
LogReplayPhase passes max(durable_version, oldest_available) as first_version, but Log.pull defines its cursor as exclusive and TransactionStreams filters version greater than the cursor. Shale recovery also writes an empty sentinel at first_version. When first_version is the source WAL's actual oldest retained transaction, that real transaction is skipped and replaced by the sentinel.

Observed reproduction:
A source containing mutations at versions 1 and 2 reported range {1, 2}; the recovered log contained an empty version 1 sentinel and only the version 2 mutation.

Impact:
Deterministic data loss during ordinary restart recovery after WAL trimming.

Acceptance criteria:
- The replay range contract is made unambiguous and consistent end to end.
- Recovery copies the real transaction at the oldest retained boundary exactly once.
- Sentinel initialization cannot overwrite or stand in for a real source transaction.
- Integration tests use actual Shale source and destination logs for trimmed and untrimmed boundaries, including first == last and gaps.
- Documentation and type specs state whether every boundary is inclusive or exclusive.
title: Preserve the first retained transaction during log replay
